AI CHEF FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Apple Intelligence reads the family pantry and writes recipes everyone can eat. Allergens flagged. Picky eaters considered. Done in seconds, on-device, fully private.

WEEKLY FAMILY WRAP
Every Sunday, see your family's combined impact: meals saved, money kept, CO₂ avoided. A cinematic recap built to share — perfect for the family WhatsApp.

ALL THE FRESHLI+ FEATURES
• Unlimited pantry items (free tier capped at 30)
• Advanced expiry analytics
• Recipe history and meal-prep planner
• Live Activities for cooking timers
• Apple Watch complications
• Priority support

14-DAY FREE TRIAL
Try Freshli+ Family free for 14 days. £5.99/month after, billed via Apple ID. Cancel anytime in Settings.

Privacy first: family pantry data stays on each device, syncs via iCloud, never touches Freshli's servers.

For your family. For the planet.
